content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). If the situation is less critical, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as a complete blood count or kidney function tests, may be required while using this medication. It is essential to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to take action promptly. Contact your doctor or pharmacist to establish a new dosing schedule. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines and consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last updated in August 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. Always seek advice from your healthcare professional for complete and personalized information about this product and your health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this drug with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most current information, contact the applicable plan provider. If you send this information to a recipient, they will receive further details and instructions on how to access the offer.
